第2490章 九霄帝剑（第1页）
九霄帝剑（九霄帝剑（第22页）就在众人以为，黑暗帝庭会被一剑斩断的时候，忽然，一尊恐怖的手掌从帝庭深处探出，像是大帝的掌印，又像是帝道纹络构筑而成的神通，就这么迎了上去，想要阻止九霄帝剑。“就算你为准帝，也不可能徒手对抗九霄帝剑！”九霄圣王冷哂。可接下来的一幕却让他错愕，当那恐怖手掌和九霄帝剑的碰撞的刹那，九霄帝剑的光芒竟暗淡了几分，被手掌震飞出去，而那恐怖手掌也在剑威下湮灭。万界剧震，强盛而剧烈的波动疯狂蔓延开来，就连边荒之地都受到了冲击，整座世界古树都在摇晃！若非黑暗帝主出手，稳固了黑暗帝庭，这座庞然大物说不定也会被震成齑粉。“竟然挡下了九霄帝剑！”尽管那恐怖手掌也被粉碎，但太初神主和黄金族长仍然大为惊撼，这世上竟然还有人能够对抗帝兵！两大圣王拥有帝兵，没有间隔太远，足以自保。“他真的成帝了吗？”这是不少人内心的想法，黑暗帝主，自号帝主，他真的只是准帝吗？若是准帝，能够这样正面击飞九霄帝剑吗？“帝剑没有完全复苏，不算处在最强的状态下，若是帝道法则全面呈现，我不信你还能接下！”九霄圣王暴喝，九霄帝剑也发出长啸之声，它是大帝的兵器，虽然大帝不在了，但它也是无匹的，这世上没什么能阻挡它才对！帝剑的辉芒更加耀眼，让众人都快看不清九霄圣王了，只有浓郁的帝道气息在流转，澎湃至极。与此同时，太初神主和黄金族长也没有闲着，各自祭出了帝兵，要一同征伐黑暗帝主。一面仙镜横空，混沌气缭绕，映照出刺目的太初之光。在镜光的照耀下，一切的道与法仿佛都要成空，红尘俗世的种种，仿佛都在镜中呈现，内蕴万千世界。这是太初仙镜，有传言称，仙镜之中，能够窥到太古的仙界！关于此镜的来历，众说纷纭，没有人能说得清。有人认为它乃是远古大帝的兵器，却也有人认为，此镜中暗藏仙道之气，应该属于太古的仙！具体的情况，连太初神主都无法说清，但不管是哪种说法，都足以说明此镜的强横与不凡！另一处方位，黄金之光照亮了九天十地，一尊由极道仙金打造而成的神鞭浮现，赫然是黄金古族的帝兵，黄金鞭！在黄金鞭上，刻有一尊又一尊的身影，像是古老的仙，还有其他至强的生灵。随着黄金族长的催动，这些身影竟都从黄金鞭上显化而出，环绕在四周，吞吐帝道之光！萧沉动容，三大帝兵，都复苏到了绝巅状态！“看来你们非要逼我走出帝庭，那好，今日你们就都不必走了！”一道清啸回荡在整片虚无空间，帝庭深处，一股帝道神光冲出，三千大世界仿佛都被推动，狂暴无边，让三大帝兵都受到了冲击！

Chapter 2490 Nine Heavens Emperor Sword (page 1)
Jiuxiao Emperor Sword (Nine Heavens Emperor Sword (page 22)) Just when everyone thought that the Dark Emperor Court would be cut off with a sword, suddenly, a terrifying palm protruded from the depths of the Emperor Court, like the palm print of the Great Emperor, and The divine power, which was made up of the imperial pattern, just stepped forward, trying to stop the Jiuxiao Emperor Sword. "Even if you are the quasi-emperor, you can't fight against the Jiuxiao Emperor Sword with your bare hands!" Jiuxiao Holy King said coldly. The scene that came made him stunned. When the terrifying palm collided with the Nine Heavens Emperor Sword, the light of the Nine Heavens Emperor Sword dimmed a bit and was blown away by the palm. The terrifying palm was also annihilated by the power of the sword. The world was shaken, powerful and violent fluctuations spread crazily, even the borderlands were affected, and the entire world's ancient trees were shaking! If the Dark Emperor hadn't taken action to stabilize the Dark Emperor's Court, this would have been impossible. This behemoth might have been shattered into pieces. "He actually blocked the Nine Heavens Emperor Sword!" Although the terrifying palm was also shattered, the Supreme God Lord and the Golden Clan Chief were still shocked that there were still people in this world who could resist the emperor's weapons! The two holy kings had imperial weapons, and they were not too far apart to protect themselves. "Has he really become the emperor?" This is the inner thought of many people. The Dark Emperor calls himself the Emperor. Is it just the quasi-emperor? If he is the quasi-emperor, can he hit the Nine Heavens Emperor Sword head-on like this? "The Emperor Sword has not fully recovered, and it is not in its strongest state. If the Emperor's Law is fully present, I don't believe you can take it!" The Nine Heavens Holy King shouted loudly, and the Nine Heavens Emperor Sword also roared. It is the weapon of the Emperor. Although the Emperor is gone, it is also unmatched. Nothing in this world can stop it! The radiance became even more dazzling, making it almost impossible for everyone to see the Holy King of the Nine Heavens. Only the strong aura of the Emperor's Dao was circulating. At the same time, the Supreme God Lord and the Golden Patriarch were not idle. They each sacrificed their imperial soldiers to conquer the Dark Emperor together. A fairy mirror spread across the sky, filled with chaos, reflecting the dazzling light of the Supreme Beginning. Under the light of the mirror, all the Dao and the law seemed to be empty. Everything in the world seems to be reflected in the mirror, and it contains thousands of worlds. It is rumored that the ancient fairy world can be seen in the fairy mirror! There are different opinions about the origin of this mirror, and no one can tell clearly. Some people think that it is the weapon of the ancient emperor, but some people think that the immortal energy hidden in this mirror should belong to the ancient immortal! , but no matter which theory is used, it is enough to illustrate the power and extraordinaryness of this mirror! In another position, the light of gold illuminates the nine heavens and the earth, and a divine whip made of Ji Dao Immortal Gold emerges. It is the imperial weapon of the Golden Ancient Clan, the Golden Whip! On the golden whip, there are figures one after another, like ancient immortals, and other powerful creatures. With the urging of the Golden Clan Leader, these figures all came out of the Yellow Clan. The golden whip appeared, surrounding it, swallowing the light of the Emperor's Dao! Xiao Chen's face was moved, and the three Imperial Soldiers were all revived to their peak state! "It seems that you have to force me to leave the Imperial Court. Well, you don't have to leave today!" A clear roar echoed in the entire void space, and from the depths of the Imperial Court, a divine light of the Imperial Dao rushed out, and the three thousand worlds seemed to be pushed, and the violence was boundless, and the three Imperial Soldiers were shocked!
